description: This file defines a base class for Large Language Model (LLM) services with function calling support, including registration, management, and execution of functions, along with frame processing for LLM interactions. It also manages event hooks, asynchronous execution modes, and integration with specific LLM adapters.

classes.name: FunctionCallResultCallback
classes.description: Protocol for asynchronous callbacks handling the result of an LLM function call execution.

classes.name: FunctionCallParams
classes.description: Data class encapsulating parameters related to a function call, including the function name, arguments, context, and result callback.

classes.name: FunctionCallRegistryItem
classes.description: Data class representing registered function call handlers, including handler info and behavior flags.

classes.name: FunctionCallRunnerItem
classes.description: Internal class for managing function call execution in the runner queue or parallel execution.

classes.name: LLMService
classes.description: Base class for LLM services supporting function registration, execution, frame processing, and event management.

methods.name: BaseLLMAdapter get_llm_adapter(self)
methods.description: Returns the current LLM adapter instance.

methods.name: LLMSpecificMessage create_llm_specific_message(self, message: Any)
methods.description: Creates an LLM-specific message for internal use.

methods.name: Optional[str] run_inference(self, context: LLMContext | OpenAILLMContext)
methods.description: Abstract method to run inference with the LLM, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: Any create_context_aggregator( self, context: OpenAILLMContext, *, user_params: LLMUserAggregatorParams = LLMUserAggregatorParams(), assistant_params: LLMAssistantAggregatorParams = LLMAssistantAggregatorParams(), )
methods.description: Creates a context aggregator; deprecated in favor of newer context management approaches.

methods.name: start(self, frame: StartFrame)
methods.description: Starts the LLM service and initializes necessary tasks or flags.

methods.name: stop(self, frame: EndFrame)
methods.description: Stops the LLM service and cancels ongoing tasks as needed.

methods.name: cancel(self, frame: CancelFrame)
methods.description: Handles explicit cancellation of the service.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling specific types like interruptions or configurations.

methods.name: push_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection = FrameDirection.DOWNSTREAM)
methods.description: Pushes frames downstream or upstream, with specific handling for TTS skipping.

methods.name: _handle_interruptions(self, _: InterruptionFrame)
methods.description: Cancels function calls that are marked to cancel on interruption.

methods.name: register_function( self, function_name: Optional[str], handler: Any, start_callback=None, *, cancel_on_interruption: bool = True, )
methods.description: Registers a handler for specific function calls, with handling for deprecated parameters.

methods.name: register_direct_function( self, handler: DirectFunction, *, cancel_on_interruption: bool = True, )
methods.description: Registers a direct function handler, automatically extracting metadata.

methods.name: unregister_function(self, function_name: Optional[str])
methods.description: Removes a registered function handler.

methods.name: unregister_direct_function(self, handler: Any)
methods.description: Removes a registered direct function handler.

methods.name: has_function(self, function_name: str)
methods.description: Checks if a function handler is registered for a given name.

methods.name: run_function_calls(self, function_calls: Sequence[FunctionCallFromLLM])
methods.description: Executes a list of function calls, managing parallel or sequential execution based on configuration.

methods.name: request_image_frame( self, user_id: str, *, function_name: Optional[str] = None, tool_call_id: Optional[str] = None, text_content: Optional[str] = None, video_source: Optional[str] = None, timeout: Optional[float] = 10.0, )
methods.description: Deprecated method to request an image from a user, now replaced by frame pushing.

methods.name: _create_sequential_runner_task(self)
methods.description: Initializes a background task to run function calls sequentially.

methods.name: _cancel_sequential_runner_task(self)
methods.description: Cancels the sequential function call runner task.

methods.name: _sequential_runner_handler(self)
methods.description: Handler loop for processing queued function calls sequentially.

methods.name: _run_parallel_function_calls(self, runner_items: Sequence[FunctionCallRunnerItem])
methods.description: Launches all function calls in parallel.

methods.name: _run_sequential_function_calls(self, runner_items: Sequence[FunctionCallRunnerItem])
methods.description: Enqueues function calls for sequential execution.

methods.name: _call_start_function( self, context: OpenAILLMContext | LLMContext, function_name: str )
methods.description: Invokes start callback for a function if registered.

methods.name: _run_function_call(self, runner_item: FunctionCallRunnerItem)
methods.description: Executes a single function call, including invoking the handler and broadcasting frames.

methods.name: _cancel_function_call(self, function_name: Optional[str])
methods.description: Cancels ongoing function calls for a specific function name.

methods.name: _function_call_task_finished(self, task: asyncio.Task)
methods.description: Callback invoked when a function call task completes, cleaning up internal state.

methods.description: unavailable

methods.description: unavailable
